stories.title: IHC suspends Islamabad local govt election schedule
stories.brief: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Friday suspended the Election Commission of Pakistan's (ECP) schedule for local government elections in the federal capital, which were scheduled for December 20, and sought responses from the commission and other respondents by November 26.

stories.title: Why is the Microsoft outage lasting so long?
stories.brief: Microsoft says it is seeing "improvements" following a global outage but efforts to fully resume services are ongoing.

stories.title: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
stories.brief: Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself.

stories.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
stories.brief: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

stories.title: What happened overnight with the Microsoft global outage?
stories.brief: Microsoft is struggling to fix a global outage, with services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot affected by "connectivity problems".

stories.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy
stories.brief: Huang abruptly quit on Thursday as head of one of the world's most valuable companies after revelations of alleged extramarital affairs.

stories.title: Pakistan, bad weather hold Sri Lanka to draw in first Test
stories.brief: Led by Saud Shakeel and aided by bad weather, Pakistan foiled Sri Lanka’s bid for victory as the first Test ended in a draw on the fifth and final day in Rawalpindi on Friday.

stories.title: SC rules inheritance rights do not expire with time
stories.brief: The court clarified that the limitation period for filing an inheritance claim begins only when the heir is made aware of a clear denial of their ownership rights.

stories.title: Dar reviews austerity measures, calls for PNSC restructuring with global consultants
stories.brief: Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 chaired a meeting of the Committee for Monitoring and Implementation of Conservation and Additional Austerity Measures at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

stories.title: Saud Shakeel misses century as Pakistan-Sri Lanka Test ends in a draw
stories.brief: Saud, who had scored 93 in the first innings, once again failed to complete what could have been his fifth Test century as Pakistan declared their second innings at 284-8.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz calls for mineral development alongside environmental protection
stories.brief: Addressing the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 in Islamabad, he said responsible mining and environmental conservation must go hand in hand, adding that the government would ensure mineral development did not come at the expense of the environment.

stories.title: Chris Van Hollen announces run for US Senate majority leader, challenging Schumer
stories.brief: Democratic United States Senator Chris Van Hollen said on Thursday he would run for Senate majority leader, challenging Chuck Schumer, who has led the Democrats in the Senate since 2017, after the Democratic Party won a majority in the chamber in the midterm elections.

stories.title: Pakistan strongly condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, supports UN-led Yemen peace efforts
stories.brief: Pakistan strongly condemned continued Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia and called for their immediate and unconditional cessation, while reaffirming its support for the Kingdom's sovereignty, security and territorial integrity. "Pakistan condemns in the strongest terms the continued Houthi terrorist attacks against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia," Ambassador Shah said.

stories.title: Security forces kill 74 terrorists in K-P, Balochistan operations: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces killed 74 terrorists during intelligence-based operations in Balochistan and Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa, the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Friday. He said the recovery of weapons, ammunition and explosives from the terrorists' possession demonstrated the effectiveness of the security forces' operations.

stories.title: Bessent blames Lutnick's Commerce Department for failing to block Megaspeed
stories.brief: Scott Bessent told CNBC that several government agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months".

stories.title: Iran says it targeted US military radar in Bahrain in retaliatory strike
stories.brief: First direct attack on US military installations for months was in response to US airstrike on communications towerIran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it has targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to a US airstrike on a communications tower in Sirik overlooking the strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Delhi overtakes Lahore as world’s most polluted city
stories.brief: India’s capital New Delhi has overtaken Pakistan’s Lahore as the world’s most polluted city.

stories.title: Mauricio Pochettino announced as new Manchester United manager
stories.brief: Pochettino replaces Michael Carrick, who was sacked after United's disastrous start to the season.

stories.title: Iran threatens unlimited response over Strait of Hormuz after US attack
stories.brief: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain.

stories.title: Nvidia scandal: Howard Lutnick under pressure over alleged lack of action
